passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: L. DEBT Revolving Credit Facility On May 1, 2020, Teradyne entered into a credit agreement (the “Credit Agreement”) with Truist Bank, as administrative agent and collateral agent, and the lenders party thereto. The Credit Agreement provides for a three-year , senior secured revolving credit facility of $ 400.0 million (the “Credit Facility”). On December 10, 2021, the Credit Agreement was amended to extend the maturity date of the Credit Facility to December 10, 2026. On October 5, 2022, the Credit Agreement was amended to increase the amount of the Credit Facility to $ 750.0 million from $ 400.0 million. On November 7, 2023, the Credit Agreement was amended to allow for the purchase of the shares of Technoprobe. The Credit Agreement provides that, subject to customary conditions, Teradyne may seek to obtain from existing or new lenders the available incremental amount under the Credit Facility, not to exceed the greater of $ 200.0 million or 15 % of consolidated EBIDTA. The interest rate applicable to loans under the Credit Facility are, at Teradyne’s option, equal to either a base rate plus a margin ranging from 0.00 % to 0.75 % per annum or SOFR plus a margin ranging from 1.10 % to 1.85 % per annum, based on the consolidated leverage ratio of Teradyne. In addition, Teradyne will pay a commitment fee on the unused portion of the commitments under the Credit Facility ranging from 0.15 % to 0.25 % per annum, based on the then applicable consolidated leverage ratio. Teradyne is not required to repay any loans under the Credit Facility prior to maturity, subject to certain customary exceptions. Teradyne is permitted to prepay all or any portion of the loans under the Credit Facility prior to maturity without premium or penalty, other than customary SOFR breakage costs. The Credit Agreement contains customary events of default, representations, warranties and affirmative and negative covenants that, among other things, limit Teradyne’s ability to sell assets, grant liens on assets, incur other secured indebtedness and make certain investments and restricted payments, all subject to exceptions set forth in the Credit Agreement. The Credit Agreement also requires Teradyne to satisfy two financial ratios measured as of the end of each fiscal quarter; a consolidated leverage ratio and an interest coverage ratio. The Credit Facility is guaranteed by certain of Teradyne’s domestic subsidiaries and collateralized by assets of Teradyne and such subsidiaries, including a pledge of 65 % of the capital stock of certain foreign subsidiaries.

credit_strengths.text: Teradyne's automated test and robotics franchise generates operating margins above the sector median, reflecting pricing power and a favourable product mix. Operating income has grown steadily across the three-year trend, and the resulting cash generation comfortably funds capital expenditure, leaving substantial free cash flow for distributions and acquisitions.

The balance sheet is net cash, with unrestricted cash exceeding reported borrowings, and leverage sits far below the sector median. Interest coverage is exceptionally high, and free cash flow covers debt many times over, giving ample headroom against the financial covenants in the revolving facility.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a senior secured revolving facility maturing in the near term, collateralised by domestic assets and a pledge of foreign subsidiary stock, with leverage and interest coverage covenants. A refinancing or extension would be required at maturity, and covenant compliance could constrain restricted payments or acquisitions if earnings weaken.

The risk-factor passage highlights forward-looking uncertainties tied to semiconductor capital spending cycles and customer concentration in automated test. Demand for test equipment is cyclical, and a downturn could pressure revenue and operating cash flow, while shareholder distributions and buybacks absorb most free cash flow, limiting balance-sheet flexibility.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Debt service is comfortably covered: operating income dwarfs interest expense, and free cash flow is a large multiple of reported borrowings. Cash on hand exceeds debt, so the issuer could repay the facility from liquidity alone, and the current ratio remains near the sector median, supporting short-term obligations.

Operating cash flow has grown steadily and funds capital expenditure with room to spare, leaving free cash flow that covers dividends, buybacks and acquisitions. This internally generated liquidity, combined with net cash, means servicing the revolver is not dependent on external refinancing, though the maturity remains a scheduled event.

overall_credit_view.text: Teradyne presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with net cash, leverage well below the sector median and coverage far above peers. The business is cyclical but cash-generative, and the main credit event is the upcoming revolver maturity, which we expect to be refinanced given the strong balance sheet.

Our forward view is that free cash flow will continue to fund shareholder returns and bolt-on acquisitions, keeping leverage low. A semiconductor downcycle could pressure revenue and cash flow, but the net cash position and covenant headroom provide a substantial buffer. We would monitor the debt maturity profile and any acceleration in distributions.

credit_strengths.text: Teradyne 的自動化測試及機械人業務，其營運利潤率高於行業中位數，反映其定價能力及有利的產品組合。營運收入在三年趨勢中穩步增長，而由此產生的現金生成能力足以輕鬆支付資本開支，留下大量自由現金流用於分派及收購。
資產負債表為淨現金，未受限制現金超過呈報借款，而槓桿遠低於行業中位數。利息覆蓋率極高，自由現金流覆蓋債務多倍，為循環信貸融資的財務契約提供充裕緩衝。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露一項於短期內到期的優先有抵押循環信貸融資，以境內資產及外國附屬公司股份質押作抵押，並附有槓桿及利息覆蓋率契約。到期時需要進行再融資或延期，而若盈利轉弱，契約合規可能限制受限制付款或收購。
風險因素章節強調與半導體資本開支週期及自動化測試客戶集中度相關的前瞻性不確定因素。測試設備需求具週期性，下行可能對收入及營運現金流構成壓力，而股東分派及回購吸收大部分自由現金流，限制資產負債表靈活性。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 債務償付得到輕鬆覆蓋：營運收入遠超利息開支，而自由現金流為呈報借款的較大倍數。手頭現金超過債務，因此發行人可僅以流動性償還該融資，而流動比率維持接近行業中位數，支持短期債務。
營運現金流穩步增長，並在支付資本開支後仍有餘裕，留下自由現金流覆蓋股息、回購及收購。此內部產生的流動性，加上淨現金，意味償還循環信貸並不依賴外部再融資，儘管到期仍屬既定事件。

overall_credit_view.text: Teradyne 呈現極低的指示性財務風險狀況，擁有淨現金，槓桿遠低於行業中位數，覆蓋率遠高於同業。業務具週期性但能產生現金，而主要信用事件為即將到期的循環信貸，鑑於資產負債表強勁，我們預期將進行再融資。
我們的前瞻觀點是自由現金流將繼續為股東回報及補強型收購提供資金，保持低槓桿。半導體下行週期可能對收入及現金流構成壓力，但淨現金狀況及契約緩衝提供重大緩衝。我們將監察債務到期狀況及任何分派加速。
